hardlink_assessment.option: Per-array hardlinks as a copytree replacement
hardlink_assessment.decision: Not compatible with current pinned storage contracts.
hardlink_assessment.reason: Link creation and removal change shared inode ctime. Existing source/sidecar/output identities include device, inode, size, mtime and ctime. A new sibling link can invalidate an earlier receipt without changing bytes. Shared chunk or metadata writes also affect every link. Mutable policy_target/search_wdl and recipe .zattrs must never be shared writable files.

new_cohort_status: Potential narrow implementation for a fixed recipe cohort; not currently qualified.
source_evidence: bt4_policy_mix.py:2178 copies the whole source tree before changing policy.
sf_policy_rewrite.py:283-299 copies each file and verifies compressed nonpolicy bytes; source storage stamps are checked before/finally and the summary explicitly claims 16 copied nonpolicy arrays.
bt4_value_rewrite.py:247-249 copies the source tree before opening it writable and changing search_wdl; source/output storage identities and other file hashes are checked.
adapt_raw_bt4_sidecars.py:46-65 and sf_d9_rank_sidecar.py:293-309 explicitly include inode and ctime in identity; symlinks/special files are refused.
replay/shard.py:1869-1940 currently opens a normal Zarr group and resolves arrays from that group; no common-parent view exists.
replay/game_epoch.py:264-312 commits file bytes and resolved shard paths, checking stat stability during hashing; _load_one checks content again after validated decoding.
lc0_control_train.py:640-688 already uses a read-only staging symlink farm, so training staging is not the source of full feature duplication.
sample_scope: One named 8192-row shard per eight existing completed corpora; filesystem stat only, no chunk decoding or hashing. Not a full-corpus decomposition or exact 100M savings forecast.
sample_limit: 74.2% common-array allocation is one sampled B100 shard, not a full-corpus savings estimate. No links or storage changes performed.
